## Stage 2. The jiggle those frequencies imply

Each mode carries a never-stopping swing with spread σ² = ħ/(2mω). Bond spread = the resulting spread of each bonded pair's separation. Engaged share = time-average of the bond's strength (1 at contact, falling to 0 at the reach). Rice rate = how often the most exposed alpha's outward swing passes the reach.
